test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the word from the options which is exactly opposite in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.

Hermione was pointing to the (nearest) window.
solution:
The correct answer is option no.(2) i.e. **'remote'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** 'nearest' **means located a short distance away. **(नजदीक**)

 
 
• **Example:** I was a mile from the **nearest **village.
 
 
 
• The word **'remote'** means situated far from the main center of population; distant **(दूर)**.
 
 
• **Example:** The area is** remote** from the usual tourist routes.
 
 
 
• As both the word** nearest and remote** are opposite in meaning.

Therefore,the correct answer is option no.(2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other options are:**

 
 
• **Convenient- **fitting in well with a person's needs, activities, and plans.** (सुविधाजनक)**
 
• **adjacent- **next to or adjoining something else. **(निकटवर्त)**
 
• **abutting- ** be next to or have a common boundary with.** (सटा हुआ)**
 
 

1bd:Tbb1,

T
